name: elangdell_titles
description: List the free CALI eLangdell Press law-school casebooks and course materials (torts, contracts, constitutional law, evidence, civil procedure, tax, legal research, property, criminal law …) with authors, topics, and the Creative Commons licence stated in each book. Filter by topic word or by licence id. Answers "what free open casebooks exist for evidence" and "which eLangdell titles are BY-SA". Free (0 credits); every row carries its licence.

topic.description: Optional topic word to filter on, matched against CALI's topic tags and the title, e.g. "torts", "evidence", "tax", "contracts".

license.description: Optional licence id to filter on, e.g. "CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0" or "CC-BY-SA-4.0"; a prefix like "CC-BY-SA" also works.

name: elangdell_search
description: Search the CALI eLangdell open casebook catalogue by words in a title, an author name or the description (e.g. "Witt torts", "income tax individuals", "legal research"). Returns matching titles with authors, licence and URL; pass a slug to elangdell_book for downloads. Free (0 credits).

query.description: Words to match in title, authors or description.

name: elangdell_book
description: One CALI eLangdell title in full: authors, description, topics, the PDF / EPUB / Word download links on cali.org, and the exact Creative Commons licence and suggested attribution read from the book's own front matter. Takes the slug from elangdell_titles or elangdell_search (e.g. "tort-law-21st-century-approach"). Free (0 credits).

slug.description: The title's slug as listed by elangdell_titles, e.g. "sources-american-law-introduction-legal-research". A cali.org/books/… URL is accepted too.
